meal.title: Set GCC as Code::Blocks Default Compiler
meal.objective: Select GNU GCC as the default compiler in Code::Blocks

voice.script: Which compiler does Code::Blocks use by default? Most beginners end up with a different toolchain. In Code::Blocks, a compiler is the program that turns your C code into an executable. GCC stands for GNU Compiler Collection, a free and widely used compiler. To tell Code::Blocks to use GCC for every project, open the Settings menu, choose Compiler, then select GNU GCC Compiler from the drop‑down list. Click the Set as default button, then press OK. From now on any new project will be built with GCC automatically.
